title: Dear Lord, Hear My Prayer
firstLine: Dear Lord, grant me Thy loving care,

lines: Dear Lord, grant me Thy loving care,
And listen to my earnest prayer.
O keep me in Thy perfect way,
In Jesus' Holy name, I pray.
Dear Lord, I pray on bended knee,
In mercy hear my humble plea.
My soul lift up from Satan's snare
To live for Christ whose name I wear.
Dear Lord, when my short life is over,
O take me home forever more,
To dwell with Thee in heaven above,
And share in praise Thy endless love.
